name: Cuboid Manipulation State
description: State variables tracked from video frames + Isaac Sim pose stream. Cuboid locations are symbolic (table/basket/held/<custom>); literal coordinates are sourced from the /scene/object_poses ROS 2 topic and injected by the runtime, not inferred visually. Treat location transitions as monotonic unless you positively observe a change.

current_phase.description: Current high-level phase of the task

current_action.description: Specific action currently being performed (must match a DAG node id)

human_state.description: Current activity of the human operator

cuboid_red_location.description: Symbolic location of the red cuboid. One of: table, basket, held, or a custom drop-zone id from task_profile.drop_zones.

cuboid_green_location.description: Symbolic location of the green cuboid.

cuboid_blue_location.description: Symbolic location of the blue cuboid.

cuboid_yellow_location.description: Symbolic location of the yellow cuboid.

cuboid_orange_location.description: Symbolic location of the orange cuboid.

cuboid_red_xy.description: Live (x,y) position of the red cuboid as 'x,y' in meters, sourced from /scene/object_poses. Populated by the runtime; the vision LLM should not guess it.

cuboid_green_xy.description: Live (x,y) of the green cuboid in meters from /scene/object_poses.

cuboid_blue_xy.description: Live (x,y) of the blue cuboid in meters from /scene/object_poses.

cuboid_yellow_xy.description: Live (x,y) of the yellow cuboid in meters from /scene/object_poses.

cuboid_orange_xy.description: Live (x,y) of the orange cuboid in meters from /scene/object_poses.

held_cuboid.description: Id of the cuboid currently grasped by the robot, or empty string if none.

active_instruction.description: Current natural-language instruction from the human (e.g., 'put the red one in the basket', 'stack blue on green'). Empty until the human issues one.

prediction_confidence.description: Confidence in the predicted next action (0-1)

robot_state.description: Robot execution status (populated from robot API)

robot_active_program.description: Current robot program id when busy
